items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Manuel Sayles was saying last night... That he's one of the first ones around here at least that ever taught the fellas what chords to play on any instrument.

ctx.x: We forgot to put the date on here Bill.

Manuel Sayles was saying last night when we picked this up or night before that he thought David Jones got the credit for really introducing cards. Before that nobody ever paid any attention between one card and another here to know what they were. That he's one of the first ones around here at least that ever taught the fellas what chords to play on any instrument. That was really conscious of what one card from another.
David Jones didn't. That's the man did that. Professor Holmes? Professor Holmes.
